cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Strategic Retreat
cards.instruction: Describe every loss of control as a deliberate concession made from strength.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've handed you the chess-club chairmanship so you can develop. Start by checking tonight's fixture list, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You lost the vote. I need the cupboard key for the match.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'm releasing equipment control as well. Count the sets before handing them out; that's the proper sequence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Remove yourself as administrator too. I can't change the fixtures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'm giving you independent control. Once I've removed my access, check every date before you publish. Independence still requires accuracy.
